title: 교실 물건: 책, 공책, 연필, 칠판
objective: By the end, you can name ten common classroom objects in Korean and use them in short sentences, such as asking for a pencil or saying where your notebook is.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for the things you see and use in a Korean classroom.

task.title: Use the classroom words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, write, or order the Korean words to answer it.

words.exampleMeaning: Write your name in your notebook.
Do you happen to have a pencil?
Could you give me the eraser, please?
What floor is the classroom on?

words.meaning: board (blackboard or whiteboard at the front of the room)

words.exampleMeaning: Don't put your phone on the desk.
Please sit down in your chair.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 학교에 ( 가방 / 칠판 )을 가지고 가요. ② 선생님이 ( 칠판 / 가방 )에 글씨를 써요. ③ 수업 시간에 ( 의자 / 칠판 )에 앉아요.
Fill in the blank with a word from this worksheet: ① 연필로 썼어요. 그런데 틀렸어요. ____ 있어요? ② 수업을 하는 방은 우리 ____이에요. 3층에 있어요.
Choose the word that does not belong (you cannot write with it): 연필 / 볼펜 / 의자
Read and answer in English: 제 책상 위에 책하고 볼펜이 있어요. 연필은 없어요. — What is NOT on the desk?
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 있어요 / 공책이 / 가방 안에
answers: ① 가방 ② 칠판 ③ 의자
가방 안에 공책이 있어요. (공책이 가방 안에 있어요.)
